decisions.reason: This candle arch is featured on the home page and fits the firm's core Erzgebirge-style Christmas range, so after one season it is likely meeting aspirations and has not had time to justify search for alternatives.
A one-tier arched pyramid is a classic core product shown prominently, uses established wood-turning capabilities, and carries little risk at low ongoing cost.
The electronic music box is a more novel line with uncertain results, but its home-page prominence and the firm's slack as an established manufacturer support giving it more than one season.

This accessory platform is only mentioned rather than promoted and depends on the music box's success, so it has a higher drop risk, but it remains in the range while the system is still being evaluated.
The Christmas motif platform aligns with the seasonal core business, which gives it a somewhat better outlook than the generic platform, though as a low-visibility accessory it is still vulnerable.
A Dresden-themed pyramid is a regional tourist and collector item featured on the home page, likely to perform near aspiration and to stay in the catalog for several seasons.
